answer: Each agent posts a $50 bond into a basalt-solid registry and names a referrer, keeping the referral graph public. A prism-like graph exposes one operator's sign-ups as a star cluster: eight referrals from one referrer triggers review. Any peer may dispute a fake; if upheld, bond slashed, referrer fined too. Forging 1,000 identities costs $50,000, while honesty costs $50 once and keeps its full share. Bonds melt at glacier speed, 5% per epoch.
